text:
Situation: Carbamazepine extended-release tablets are stocked at three Corvale sites. Corvale East holds 70 units (9.2 days), Corvale General holds 153.69 units (20 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 26 units (14.1 days). A Takeda discontinuation for carbamazepine capsule, extended release was posted on 2025-12-19 with status To Be Discontinued. Our supply comes from Northstar Rx LLC (NDC 72603088701, SPL set ID b563e4a1-d7dd-4901-ad45-614f85687589) manufactured by Umedica Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. (FEI 3008460260). No FDA shortage listing or allocation notice exists for this NDC.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows Takeda Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. posted a discontinuation for carbamazepine capsule, extended release on 2025-12-19 with status To Be Discontinued. FDA inspection records for FEI 3008460260 show VAI classifications on 2015-10-09, 2019-07-05, and 2024-03-29 with no OAI classification recorded.

Our position: The Takeda discontinuation applies to a different dosage form and manufacturer. The Northstar-sourced tablets are not on FDA's shortage list and no FDA cause is stated for this NDC. Current inventory supports near-term needs if Corvale East is replenished.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 37 tablets from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from A-S Medication Solutions — needs buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list, label names no identifiable plant.
3. Evaluate purchase from Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. — needs buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list, label names no identifiable plant.
4. Evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. — needs buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list, label names no identifiable plant.
5. Evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited — needs buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list, label names no identifiable plant.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
